{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.index[0]
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel, best_channel, best_revenue"}
